description: The support chat talks to support over a WebSocket. When a customer sends a message, the page sends it as {"type":"message","text":...} and support replies with Support received: followed by the customer's words.
acceptanceCriteria: The chat shows Online once connected.
A message the customer sends goes out over the WebSocket, and the reply repeats the customer's words after Support received:.
